description: Header file defining the MigrationPreparerImplementation class, which implements the IMigrationPreparer interface for managing migration data store, component readiness, and related utilities within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: MigrationPreparerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IMigrationPreparer interface, providing methods for data store management, component readiness, and reset functionalities within the migration process.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to the data store.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the data store by key.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value from the data store by key.

methods.name: setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Sets the readiness state for a specified component.

methods.name: getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components marked as ready.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the migration data store or related state based on reset type.
